title: Tissue-anchored regional expression contrasts in colorectal cancer Visium data
description: Analysis code, frozen known-boundary simulation manifest and derived results for a morphology-defined near-versus-far stromal expression comparison in two public colorectal cancer Visium resources. This version includes patient-aware real-resource summaries, conditional simulation calibration, figure source tables and provenance. Earlier cross-method benchmark outputs remain available. The real-resource results are descriptive and do not demonstrate local histological-boundary movement or a supported primary direction reversal.
